第516章 师父帮我个忙（第1页）
虞既白歪头，想着待墨微尘情绪好了之后他再离开回岱舆山，光幕上便又出现了一行字。
思绪回神，墨微尘抬眸，就见虞既白安安静静地坐在那里，脸上扬着浅浅的笑，眼底却难掩担忧。
他叹了口气，摆了摆手，出言提醒道：“罢了，你也在此陪了我够长时间了，我想开后就没什么事了，不必担心。”
“你还是快回你的清弦峰吧，那里有惊喜等着你呢。”
清弦峰能有什么惊喜，莫不是墨微尘这人又在他的院子里种了几个地雷阵盘？
墨微尘朝虞既白眨了眨眼，终究是没有明说，只是起身把人连推带撵地送出了神机峰。
虞既白稀里糊涂地被推搡着进了阵法。
位移阵法瞬间启动，一阵空间波动传来，几瞬过后，虞既白就已经站在了清弦峰上。
冷千双回了紫霄殿后，又把风云大赛的作战方案核实一遍后，便向殿外传音要萧杙去见他。
萧杙收到传音后看向温郗：“小郗，你要随我一起见师父还是我送你回清弦峰？”
温郗正在摆弄着花瓣，闻言想了想：“不去见你师父，不用你送，我自己回清弦峰就好，另外，萧杙，不要告诉任何人你今日见了我，就当我还没苏醒，仍在岱舆山。”
反正岱舆温氏那边向来嘴严，她的所有消息都被瞒的很好。
“好。”萧杙没有半点犹豫，对温郗的所有决定都无条件支持，从不过问缘由。
“我回来的时候，见神机峰上面雷云还没完全散去，是不是阿言渡劫了？”
温郗点了点头，也不知道阿言选择了哪种道法，既无天道赐福立碑，想来便没有新立道法，自然是启明洲如今已有的十二种道法其一。
十二种道法在温郗脑海里过了一遍，她锁定了其中一个。
温郗悠悠地叹了口气，我的阿言，你该不会选了那个吧……

不过，那倒真的符合你的心境。只是，你该如何证道呢？
温郗目送萧杙离开了院落，自己则是转身就飞向了清弦峰。
虞既白刚刚踏入听篁居，耳边就响起了一道清丽空灵的嗓音。
虞既白一怔，还没回过神来，眼前就骤然出现一抹绿色。
“你看，我醒过来啦~”温郗窜到虞既白面前，双手一摊，原地转了个圈。
虞既白：【你……小希，那你……】
光幕闪闪烁烁半天也没卡出来一句话，温郗却像是猜到了虞既白要说什么，连忙笑着开口——
“伤都好了，经脉也修复了，修为还精进了，差一点点就能试着突破元婴了，不过紧要关头还是被我压了一下。”
毕竟满打满算她突破金丹也才一年，这么快又突破难免灵力不稳，而且要真是在两仪婆娑树里突破，那雷劫是往下劈还是不劈？这劫是算她过了还是没过？
虞既白的眼眶慢慢红了：【好……伤痊愈了就好……】
同萧杙一样，他也没想到温郗能在这种时候苏醒……虞既白有许多话想和温郗说。
温郗：“那什么，师父，我们有空再说，我现在有件事需要您帮忙，事成之后，我们有的是时间叙旧。”
温郗踮着脚在虞既白耳边说了几句话，虞既白的眼睛越睁越大。
温郗：“师父，相信我，就照我说的做吧，我自有主意。”
虞既白眸光闪了闪：【好，我一会就去】

Chapter 516 Master, do me a favor (page 1)
Yu Jibai tilted his head, thinking that he would leave and return to Daiyu Mountain after Mo Weichen's mood improved, and another line of words appeared on the light screen.
After returning to his thoughts, Mo Mochen raised his eyes and saw Yu Jibai sitting there quietly, with a slight smile on his face, but he could not hide his worry in his eyes.
He sighed, waved his hand, and warned: "That's all, you've been here with me for a long enough time. I'll be fine after I think about it, so don't worry."
"You'd better go back to your Qingxian Peak, there are surprises waiting for you there."
What surprises can Qingxian Peak have? Could it be that Mo Weichen planted a few more mine arrays in his yard?
Mo Weichen blinked at Yu Jibai, but after all he didn't say anything clearly, he just got up and pushed the person out of Shenji Peak.
Yu Jibai was pushed into the formation in a daze.
The displacement formation was activated instantly, and a burst of space fluctuations came. After a few moments, Yu Jibai was already standing on Qingxian Peak.
Leng Qianshuang returned to the Zixiao Palace, verified the battle plan for the Fengyun Competition, and then sent a message outside the palace asking Xiao Zhu to see him.
After receiving the message, Xiao Xi looked at Wen Xi: "Xiao Xi, do you want to come with me to see the master or should I send you back to Qingxian Peak?"
Wen Xi was playing with the petals. After hearing this, he thought for a while and said, "If I don't go to see your master, you don't need to send me there. I can just go back to Qingxian Peak by myself. Also, Xiao Hao, don't tell anyone that you saw me today. Just pretend that I haven't woken up yet and am still in Daiyu Mountain."
Anyway, Daiyu Wenshi has always been strict with her words, so all the news about her has been kept well hidden.
"Okay." Xiao Zhu didn't hesitate at all. He unconditionally supported all of Wen Xi's decisions and never asked about the reasons.
"When I came back, I saw that the thunderclouds on Shenji Peak had not completely dispersed. Has Ayan passed the tribulation?"
Wen Xi nodded. He didn't know which Taoist method Ayan had chosen. Since there was no blessing from heaven to set up a monument, there was no new Taoist method to be established. Naturally, it was one of the twelve existing Taoist methods in Qiming Continent.
The twelve Taoist methods went through Wen Xi's mind, and she locked on one of them.
Wen Xi sighed leisurely, my Ayan, you shouldn't have chosen that one...
However, that really suits your state of mind. But, how do you prove it?
Wen Xi watched Xiao Zhu leave the courtyard, then turned around and flew towards Qingxian Peak.
As soon as Yu Jibai stepped into Tinghuang Residence, a clear and ethereal voice sounded in his ears.
Yu Jibai was startled. Before he could recover, a flash of green suddenly appeared in front of his eyes.
"Look, I'm awake~" Wen Xi rushed to Yu Jibai, spread his hands, and spun around in circles.
Yu Jibai: [You...Xiao hope, then you...]
The light screen flickered for a long time without saying a word, but Wen Xi seemed to have guessed what Yu Jibai was going to say, and he quickly smiled and said -
"The injuries have healed, the meridians have been repaired, and the cultivation level has improved. I was almost able to try to break through the Nascent Soul, but I still suppressed him at the critical moment."
After all, it has only been a year since she broke through the golden elixir. Breaking through so quickly will inevitably lead to unstable spiritual power. And if she really breaks through in the Liangyi Whirling Tree, will the thunder tribulation strike down or not? Is she considered to have passed this calamity or not?
Yu Jibai's eyes slowly turned red: [Okay... As long as the injury is healed...]
Like Xiao Zhu, he did not expect Wen Xi to wake up at this time... Yu Jibai had many things to say to Wen Xi.
Wen Xi: "What about that, Master, let's talk about it when we have time. I have something I need your help with now. After it's done, we'll have plenty of time to catch up on old times."
Wen Xi stood on tiptoe and said a few words in Yu Jibai's ear,Yu Jibai's eyes opened wider and wider.
Wen Xi: "Master, believe me, just do as I say, I have my own ideas."
Yu Jibai's eyes flashed: [Okay, I'll be there in a minute]
